Scholarship for students with special needs: The purpose of the scholarship is to support the higher education of students with special needs.
Scholarship for students with special needs: Students of professional higher education, bachelor’s, master’s, integrated and doctoral studies have the right to apply for the scholarship.
Scholarship for students with special needs: Applications for the 2026/27 academic year open on 1 September 2026.

Scholarship for students with special needs: APPLY
Scholarship for students with special needs: Applications for the scholarship are accepted only through the electronic application system .
Scholarship for students with special needs: Each application must include a digitally signed consent form for the processing of personal data and for making data inquiries.
Scholarship for students with special needs: When submitting your application, please choose one of the following consent forms:
Scholarship for students with special needs: In both cases, the applicant also gives consent for the processing of personal data.

For questions about the scholarship, contact:: Liis Uulman Senior Specialist, Scholarships and Grants Office Education and Youth Board +372 5917 2251 [publisher contact]
Applying for a scholarship: WHO CAN APPLY?
Applying for a scholarship: The Scholarship can be applied for by a person who is:
Applying for a scholarship: a student of professional higher education, bachelor’s, master’s, integrated and doctoral studies

Applying for a scholarship: an Estonian citizen or staying in Estonia on the basis of a long-term or temporary residence permit or a permanent or temporary right of residence, or staying in Estonia on the basis of a visa or visa-free if an agreement on visa-free travel has been concluded with a foreign state or the visa requirement has been waived with regard to citizens of a foreign state, and has submitted an application for a temporary residence permit for study
Applying for a scholarship: In order to receive the scholarship, you must have a decision of the Estonian Social Insurance Board regarding the identification of your disability.
Applying for a scholarship: The scholarship can be applied for by full-time and part-time students.
Applying for a scholarship: As well as students participating in studies who are also on academic leave.

Applying for a scholarship: Students enrolled in degree studies at a foreign institution of higher education may not apply for a scholarship, as the scholarship is granted on the basis of the Estonian Higher Education Act.
Applying for a scholarship: APPLICATION DOCUMENTS
Applying for a scholarship: Documents to be submitted with the application:

Applying for a scholarship: Part-time students or students completing their curriculum while on academic leave must submit a certificate of subject registration, confirmed by the higher education institution

Applying for a scholarship: A full-time student who continues their studies in the year following the nominal duration of the curriculum must also submit a certificate of subject registration issued by the higher education institution.
Applying for a scholarship: SCHOLARSHIP PAYMENT AND REPORTING
Applying for a scholarship: The decision on whether to grant or deny the scholarship will be made no later than 45 calendar days after the application is submitted.
Applying for a scholarship: The applicant will be notified in writing within five (5) working days from the date the decision is made.
Applying for a scholarship: Payments are made by the 10th of each month.

Applying for a scholarship: Students on part-time and academic leave but participating in studies must submit a certificate of the subjects together with the credits before the beginning of the spring semester.

Applying for a scholarship: The Board may award and pay the scholarship for full-time studies from the month of application submission for up to ten academic months, and for part-time studies or studies undertaken during academic leave from the month of application submission until the end of the semester.
Applying for a scholarship: No scholarship payments are made for July and August.
